channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Renan Santos: 'O que mais tem no Brasil é militar vagabundo que não faz nada'
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate from the Missão à Presidência party, claimed Brazil has a large number of 'lazy' military personnel who, instead of fighting criminal factions, prefer spending time at military clubs. He criticized the Armed Forces' inactivity amid rising organized violence.

item.title: Mensagens de Lulinha anexadas pela PF sugerem intermediação de agendas junto ao Planalto
item.description: Messages from Lulinha, son of President Lula, attached to PF investigations suggest he acted as an intermediary to schedule contacts with the presidential office. The communications were obtained in STF-authorized inquiries into suspected influence peddling and illegal consultancy contracts. The case raises concerns about the use of familial influence to gain access to government decision-making.

item.title: Roscoe celebra apoio de Cleitinho a Flávio Bolsonaro em MG
item.description: Flávio Roscoe, the PL candidate for governor of Minas Gerais, celebrated the support of Senator Cleitinho Azevedo (Republicanos) for Flávio Bolsonaro’s (PL) presidential bid, stating the support came because of the PL’s gubernatorial candidacy in Minas Gerais. The campaign launch event took place at Mackenzie Esporte Clube in Belo Horizonte, featuring Flávio Bolsonaro and over 100 legislative candidates, with whom Roscoe recorded supportive videos. Roscoe emphasized Bolsonaro’s importance to his electoral strategy, including joint committees, digital media, and radio/TV advertising, noting his coalition will have the second-largest TV time allocation.

item.title: Petrobras diz não saber quanto de petróleo há na Margem Equatorial
item.description: Petrobras President Magda Chambriard stated the company does not yet know the exact volume of oil reserves in the Equatorial Margin but remains optimistic following initial discoveries at the Morpho well in block FZA-M-59, 175 km off the coast of Amapá. The drilling is in the exploratory phase, with plans to drill three more wells in the same block and five in the broader area, backed by a projected $3 billion investment. Production hinges on commercial confirmation, development planning, and new environmental licensing.

item.title: TSE aceita ação sobre financiamento público de desfile no carnaval que homenageou Lula
item.description: The TSE has accepted a lawsuit filed by the Novo Party investigating the use of R$ 9.65 million in public funds to finance the Acadêmicos de Niterói samba school's Carnival 2025 parade, which honored President Lula. The action alleges economic abuse of power and premature electoral propaganda, as the funding was formalized after the tribute was announced in July 2025 and occurred outside the electoral propaganda regime. Lula and Geraldo Alckmin have five days to present their defense.

item.title: Lula: petróleo da Margem Equatorial pode ser opção se Trump fechar Ormuz
item.description: President Lula stated that the recent oil discovery in Brazil's Equatorial Margin, specifically in the Foz do Amazonas, could serve as a global fuel alternative if the Strait of Hormuz is closed due to U.S.-Iran tensions. He praised the purity of the oil and compared the discovery's emotional impact to the 2007 pre-salt find, emphasizing Petrobras' role and the importance of investment in research. The remarks were made during a visit to the NS-42 probe ship in Oiapoque, Amapá, where the Morpho well is under exploration.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro visitará MG 5 vezes antes do 1º turno, diz Roscoe
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is expected to visit Minas Gerais at least five times before the first round of the 2026 elections, according to Flávio Roscoe, PL candidate for the Tiradentes Palace. His visit on Monday (17/8) is part of a PL strategy to bolster Roscoe’s candidacy in the state, following Bolsonaro’s designation as the central figure of Bolsonarism in Minas Gerais. Roscoe said new dates are being finalized, including an event with Nikolas Ferreira on Tuesday.

item.title: Renan Santos: ‘O que mais tem no Brasil é militar vagabundo que não faz nada’
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate of the Missão party, claimed Brazil has many 'lazy' military personnel who avoid fighting organized crime while receiving high salaries. He criticized CLT labor protections, advocated for labor flexibilization to boost jobs and wages, and admitted he would negotiate with the centrão despite his anti-establishment rhetoric. He also stated that a future pension reform must include military personnel and asserted his 12 years as a political bloc leader qualify him to govern the nation.

item.title: Marçal chama Lula de “maior decepção” do Brasil
item.description: Pablo Marçal, PRTB presidential candidate and ineligible until 2032, accused President Lula of being Brazil's 'greatest disappointment,' criticizing his anti-hunger policies and travel spending, and challenged him to a Band debate despite not being invited.

item.title: Caiado troca marqueteiro um dia após início da campanha eleitoral
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) replaced his campaign strategist Paulo Vasconcellos with Marcos Carvalho just one day after launching his 2026 presidential bid. Carvalho previously worked on Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 campaign, while Vasconcellos had led victories for Cláudio Castro and Fuad Noman. Similar strategist changes occurred in the campaigns of Flávio Bolsonaro and Augusto Cury during the same timeframe.

item.title: Renan Santos promete acabar com facções criminosas em um ano se for eleito
item.description: Renan Santos, candidate of the Missão party, pledged to end criminal factions within one year if elected president. He proposed using 'enemy criminal law' and stated that police have the right to 'point their weapon at vagabonds'.

item.title: Tarcísio diz que melhora na segurança demora para ser percebida pela população
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas stated that improvements in public security indicators take time to be perceived by the population, despite the percentage of people feeling unsafe decreasing from 56% in 2022 to 46% currently. He emphasized that, in a potential second term, he aims to increase state financial support for municipal civil guards and invest in videomonitoring systems using AI, facial recognition, and automated license plate reading to combat crimes such as cellphone robberies and vehicle thefts, which directly affect public perception of safety.

item.title: De R$ 215 mil a R$ 65,1 milhões: veja o patrimônio dos candidatos ao governo de Goiás declarado ao TSE
item.description: Candidates for governor of Goiás in 2026 declared assets ranging from R$ 215 thousand to R$ 65.1 million, according to TSE records. Wilder Morais leads with the highest declared wealth, while Danilo Pinheiro (PCO) has the lowest at just R$ 215 thousand. Daniel Vilela (MDB) declared R$ 5.6 million, including 301 cattle and land holdings, and Luciana Amorim (UP) reported R$ 1.8 million, with significant investments in savings, funds, and properties across three states.

item.title: Caiado troca de marqueteiro após início da campanha
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD) replaced his campaign strategist on the second day of the official election campaign, substituting Paulo Vasconcelos with Marcos Carvalho, who previously worked on the digital strategy teams for Flávio Bolsonaro, Lula, and Jair Bolsonaro. The change was announced by campaign general coordinator Adriano da Rocha Lima, one day after the campaign officially began. The report notes it will receive further updates.

item.title: Crusoé: Presidente do PT defende investigação de Lulinha e Marcola
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, advocated for the investigation of businessman Fábio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) and former presidential aide Marcola, emphasizing full legal defense rights as any Brazilian citizen. He stated that allegations against both should be investigated according to the law, without political favoritism or persecution.

item.title: Impasse sobre Flávio fez Caiado trocar marqueteiro de campanha; entenda
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) replaced his campaign’s marketing chief following internal disagreements over how to confront Flávio Bolsonaro. Paulo Vasconcelos, who advocated a cautious national presentation before attacking Flávio, was swapped for Marcos Carvalho, who previously worked on Flávio’s and Jair Bolsonaro’s 2018 campaigns and favors a direct attack on Flávio’s lack of executive experience. The change came the day after electoral propaganda began, after Caiado had already recorded his first campaign materials.

item.title: 'Os americanos não vão resolver problema que é nosso', diz Caiado sobre ação dos EUA contra crime organizado no Brasil
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado of the PSD stated that the United States should not be responsible for combating organized crime in Brazil, arguing that Brazil must lead the fight against narcotrafficking in South America. He advocated for stronger regional cooperation among South American countries, proposing a joint police force called 'Sulpol' with cross-border access to tackle drug trafficking, arms trade, and money laundering.

item.title: Marqueteiro rompe com Ronaldo Caiado
item.description: Political marketer Paulo Vasconcelos announced his departure from Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) presidential campaign due to weeks of internal friction, as reported by the Jogo Político newsletter. Caiado's team has not yet commented on the split. The resignation comes amid growing internal divisions within the campaign.

item.title: Membro de missão dos EUA acompanha fala de Kassio sobre urnas no TSE
item.description: TSE President Kassio Nunes Marques met with international ambassadors, including U.S. Embassy Political Affairs Officer Sean R. Smith, to brief on Brazil’s electoral system and the reliability of electronic voting machines for the 2026 elections. He outlined the deployment of 560,011 machines across 498,984 electoral sections, the involvement of 2 million volunteer poll workers, and announced initiatives to counter the malicious use of AI in elections, including a Permanent Commission and an Action Plan for AI use to safeguard informational integrity.

item.title: Rede social X diz que deixou de sugerir postagens de candidatos para cumprir lei eleitoral
item.description: Elon Musk's social media platform X announced it will stop recommending candidate posts and profiles in the 'For You' feed during Brazil's official election campaign period, in compliance with electoral law. The measure, effective since March 16, uses an updated algorithm filter that excludes around 600 political accounts from suggestions. While candidate content remains accessible on their profiles, its visibility and reach are expected to decline.

item.title: Renan Santos diz que, se eleito, acabará com facções criminosas em um ano: 'Se fizer isso, eu terei tido sucesso'
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate for the Missão party, stated that if elected, he will eliminate criminal factions in Brazil within one year using tough measures and enemy criminal law. He called it humiliating that the U.S. classifies these groups as terrorists and argued Brazil must act on its own sovereignty, while accepting international cooperation — especially with the U.S. and the Netherlands — through intelligence sharing.

item.title: PT diz ser “natural” que Trump escolha o lado de Flávio
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva said it is 'natural' for the Trump administration to support Flávio Bolsonaro's candidacy, calling U.S. interference in Brazil's election 'worrisome'. He stated the PT trusts Brazil's Electoral Justice to prevent meddling and that Lula will not yield to external pressure, emphasizing national sovereignty as a core campaign theme.

item.title: Pesquisa por petróleo na Margem Equatorial “valeu a pena”, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula defended the oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin as a strategic victory for national sovereignty and Brazil's energy future, highlighting the exploratory discovery in the Amapá Basin and criticizing past sales of Petrobras assets. He stated that oil exploration does not contradict the energy transition, as Brazil will continue investing in biofuels and reducing long-term dependence on fossil fuels. The remarks were made during a visit to the NS-42 survey vessel, following Petrobras' confirmation of an oil discovery in deep waters off Amapá, still in the evaluation phase.

item.title: Aliado de Dino assume comando do TCE-MA após afastamento de sobrinho de Brandão
item.description: Former state deputy and former president of the Maranhão Legislative Assembly, Marcelo Tavares, assumed the presidency of the State Audit Court (TCE-MA) after Supreme Court Minister Flávio Dino ordered a 180-day removal of Daniel Itapary Brandão, nephew of Governor Carlos Brandão. The decision was based on suspicions of nepotism in the court’s management. Marcelo Tavares is regarded as a political ally of Flávio Dino.

item.title: Lula diz que Margem Equatorial pode ser solução se Ormuz fechar
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva stated that Brazil's Equatorial Margin could supply the world with oil if the Strait of Hormuz is closed due to a U.S.-Iran conflict, citing a recent hydrocarbon discovery by a Petrobras probe in Amapá. He framed the find as vital for national sovereignty and energy transition, following confirmation by Petrobras CEO Magda Chambriard that the discovery has been made, though economic exploitation is not yet confirmed.

item.title: Em Oiapoque, Davi comemora possível exploração de petróleo na Margem Equatorial
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre, president of the Senate and Congress, celebrated Petrobras' discovery of hydrocarbons in the Equatorial Margin during an official visit to Oiapoque (AP) alongside President Lula. He emphasized the transformative potential of oil and gas exploration for funding public education and health, particularly in Amapá, and defended national sovereignty against foreign pressure.

item.title: Fachin e Andrei se reúnem para discutir entrave da PF com Mendonça
item.description: Supreme Federal Court President Justice Luiz Edson Fachin met with Federal Police Director-General Andrei Rodrigues to address institutional tensions between the PF and Justice André Mendonça, rapporteur in investigations involving Banco Master, INSS, and President Lula’s son. The core issue is the PF’s delayed submission of evidence, citing staff shortages. The meeting aims to ease tensions and ensure cooperation between the PF and STF, with Mendonça absent from Brasília.

item.title: Lula provoca Trump ao exaltar descoberta de petróleo na Foz do Amazonas
item.description: President Lula provoked Donald Trump by highlighting Petrobras' oil discovery in the Amazon Foz, stating that if the U.S. continues its war with Iran and closes the Strait of Hormuz, Brazil could supply oil to the world. He called the discovery a "passport to secure the country's future," noting the Morpho well, 175 km off Amapá's coast, is promising but still under evaluation. Lula also said "thanks to God" the oil was found, though he admitted he doesn't know the final volume, emphasizing the potential high quality of the reservoir.

item.title: Mandato de 8 anos e magistrados de carreira: Cury defende reforma no STF
item.description: Augusto Cury, presidential candidate for Avante, proposed a reform of the STF that includes ending life tenure for justices, establishing eight-year non-renewable terms, and requiring two-thirds of the Court to be career magistrates. He also argued that nominees must not have held political office or been affiliated with parties in the five years prior to appointment, and that nominations should come from judges, prosecutors, and the OAB, with the Senate retaining final approval.

item.title: Chefão do PT mantém porta aberta para apoio de Lula a pai de Motta
item.description: Edinho Silva, national president of the Workers' Party (PT), left the door open for a possible endorsement by Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for Nabor Wanderley, father of Hugo Motta, running for Senate in Paraíba. While he publicly supported the re-election of Senator Veneziano Vital do Rêgo, he avoided commenting on Nabor, noting that Lula’s relationship with the father of the Chamber speaker is still being built. Silva said he will work to make this alliance happen, despite remaining silent so far.

item.title: Os obstáculos de Pablo Marçal para chegar às urnas em outubro
item.description: Pablo Marçal managed to register his presidential candidacy with the PRTB on the final allowed day, but he faces a judicial action that maintains his eight-year ineligibility due to the improper use of social media, known as the 'contest of cuts'. Although one of the three electoral actions against him was reversed and another is under appeal, the conviction upheld by the TRE-SP in December 2025 remains the main barrier to his participation in the 2026 elections, and it may still be challenged at the TSE.

item.title: Moraes autoriza Bolsonaro a ser atendido por dentista, sob condição de sigilo da consulta
item.description: Supreme Federal Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes authorized former President Jair Bolsonaro to attend a dental appointment, provided the date and time remain confidential. The ruling aims to ensure security and privacy for Bolsonaro, who remains under precautionary measures. The dental visit took place on Monday, the 17th, as authorized by the justice.

item.title: Tarcísio propõe criar banco público com nome de agressores de mulheres
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, running for re-election as a Republican, included in his government plan the proposal to create a public registry of names and data of individuals convicted of domestic violence. The measure aims to increase transparency and prevent future cases of violence against women. The news was published on August 17, 2026.

item.title: Equipes de Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro vão a reunião na Band, mesmo não confirmando presença em debate
item.description: The campaigns of President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) and presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sent representatives to a meeting at TV Bandeirantes on Monday (17) to discuss the rules for the upcoming Sunday (23) debate, despite neither confirming their attendance. The meeting takes place amid preparations for the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election.

item.title: Após reaproximação, Alcolumbre e Lula trocam afagos em evento da Petrobras no Amapá
item.description: President Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre exchanged public praise during a Petrobras event in Amapá, signaling their political reconciliation after a rift caused by the Senate’s rejection of Jorge Messias’ STF nomination. Alcolumbre defended Brazil’s sovereignty in offshore oil exploration in the Equatorial Margin, while Lula commended Alcolumbre for advancing key government priorities in the Senate, including the PEC to end the 6x1 work schedule, the Public Security PEC, and the critical minerals bill.

item.title: Saúde de Lula está “impecável”, diz presidente do PT
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, stated that President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, 80, has 'impeccable' health, emphasizing his daily physical activity and better condition than when he took office in 2003. He downplayed concerns about Lula's history of scalp basal cell carcinoma, noting the lesion was removed and that hat use stems from radiotherapy, which is common in Brazil. Lula removed his hat and bowed to the public during a speech in São Bernardo do Campo, reinforcing transparency about his treatment.

item.title: PT diz que irá aprimorar plano de governo de Lula durante campanha
item.description: The national president of the Workers' Party (PT), Edinho Silva, said that Lula's government plan will be refined during the campaign, emphasizing that the 84-page document presented on August 7 is an initial point and that themes such as sovereignty, combating organized crime, energy transition, and political reform will be deepened. He clarified that the official presentation of the program will occur soon, with Lula highlighting the central axes in speeches.

item.title: PT diz que vai começar a negociar apoio do Centrão no 1º turno
item.description: The PT will begin negotiating with Centrão parties starting August 17, 2026, to broaden support for Lula in the first round, even after convention deadlines. The party already has alliances with seven left-wing parties and supports candidates in 27 states, aiming to attract center and center-right factions from parties like PSD, MDB, PP, and União Brasil, which already have state-level agreements with the PT. The PT will reduce vice-presidential candidacies from 9 to 6 and maintains 19 own Senate candidacies, while backing candidates from 9 other parties.

item.title: Ordem da propaganda eleitoral de São Paulo na TV e no rádio é definida pelo TRE; confira
item.description: The TRE-SP determined the order of free electoral propaganda for the 2026 São Paulo elections, with the coalition 'Coragem Para Seguir Avançando', led by Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, being the first to appear in the state government slot. The first-round propaganda will run from August 28 to October 1, featuring 50 daily minutes in blocks and 70 minutes in insertions. Candidacies from PCB, PCO, Agir, PSTU, and UP will not receive free airtime due to the performance clause.

item.title: Caiado: Lula quer desviar atenção para tarifaço para não falar de endividamento
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD presidential candidate and former governor of Goiás, accused President Lula of using the 'tariff hike' narrative in trade negotiations with the United States as a tactic to divert attention from the rising indebtedness of the population and businesses. Caiado claimed Lula is attempting to 'deceive the voter' by emphasizing sovereignty and tariffs to avoid discussing the financial crisis affecting Brazilians.

item.title: Presidente do PT diz que Lulinha e Marcola devem ser investigados: ‘Que os dois tenham amplo direito de defesa como qualquer cidadão'
item.description: PT president Edinho Silva stated that Lula’s son Fábio Luís Lula da Silva and former chief of staff Marco Aurélio Santana Ribeiro should be investigated with full defense rights, as any citizen, and that the government fights corruption without interference. He also called for investigations into alleged R$70 million overseas transfers linked to the Bolsonaro family and a Brasília property purchase financed by BRB, referencing messages from Roberta Luchsinger suggesting a planned escape to Switzerland.

item.title: PT vai buscar alianças com o Centrão já no 1º turno, diz Edinho Silva
item.description: The national president of the PT, Edinho Silva, stated that the party will seek alliances with the Centrão already in the first round of the 2026 elections, regardless of past political positions. The statement was made after the deadline for candidacy registration ended, confirming Lula as the sole presidential candidate with support from other parties. Edinho stressed the need for dialogue with all democratic forces to build a broad front around Lula's candidacy.

item.title: Alcolumbre se acerca de Lula com ajuda de Moraes, para que os três continuem fortes
item.description: Senate President Davi Alcolumbre is moving closer to Lula, mediated by Alexandre de Moraes, to secure his 2027 re-election and shield himself from PF investigations into the secret budget and Amapá. He controls over R$1.2 billion in Amapá amendments and fears the criminalization of politics, seeking strategic alliances to maintain power. The rapprochement stems from his fear of being seen as 'old politics' if he loses influence in a potentially Bolsonaro-dominated Senate.

item.title: Sucessor de Ratinho Jr declara apoio a Caiado, mas não fecha porta para Bolsonaro e Flávio no PR
item.description: Sandro Alex, chosen by Governor Ratinho Júnior as his successor in Paraná, stated that the PSD has Ronaldo Caiado as its presidential candidate but did not rule out support for Flávio Bolsonaro, Renan, or Zema. He emphasized the strong alliance between Ratinho Júnior and former President Jair Bolsonaro, citing major infrastructure projects and investments, and avoided directly opposing his running mate Cristina Graelm’s Bolsonarist positions, saying Senate debates belong to senators.

item.title: Garantimos soberania energética, diz Silveira sobre Margem Equatorial
item.description: Minister of Mines and Energy Alexandre Silveira stated that the oil discovery in the Equatorial Margin ensures Brazil's energy sovereignty, emphasizing the country will not relinquish exploration of the resource, which holds at least 41 million barrels according to government estimates. He made the remarks during a public visit to the site in Oiapoque, Amapá, alongside President Lula and Senator Davi Alcolumbre, highlighting the importance of national wealth in fighting poverty and promoting development. Petrobras confirmed the presence of hydrocarbons but has not yet determined the economic viability of exploitation.

item.title: Caiado vê “colapso do varejo” e cita recuperação da Casas Bahia
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado (PSD), presidential candidate, stated that Brazil is experiencing a 'retail collapse', citing Casas Bahia's judicial recovery request as evidence. He linked the crisis to high interest rates (14%), household indebtedness, and criticized the Desenrola program for not addressing root causes, advocating for fiscal adjustment instead.

item.title: Marcelinho, Luís Fabiano e Edmundo lideram patrimônio entre boleiros
item.description: Marcelinho Carioca leads in declared wealth among former Brazilian football players running in the 2026 elections, with R$ 45.4 million, followed by Luís Fabiano (R$ 20.1 million) and Edmundo (R$ 16 million). The eight candidates include former strikers, midfielders, and a Flamengo executive, running for district deputy, federal deputy, and state governor.

item.title: Mendonça manda redes tirarem do ar vídeo com deepfake de Flávio
item.description: Minister André Mendonça of the TSE ordered X and TikTok to remove within 24 hours a deepfake video falsely attributing offensive statements to Flávio Bolsonaro and Alfredo Gaspar, PL’s presidential and vice-presidential candidates. The ruling, granted as an urgent injunction, deems the content as illegal early negative electoral propaganda and prohibits the use of deepfakes without disclosure. The PL claims the video harms the candidates’ reputations and spreads known falsehoods.

item.title: Moraes decide local para atendimento odontológico de Bolsonaro
item.description: Supreme Court Minister Alexandre de Moraes authorized dental treatment for former President Jair Bolsonaro, but required the appointment to take place at the Military Police Medical Center in the Federal District. The defense had requested that Fernanda Bolsonaro, wife of Flávio Bolsonaro, serve as the treating dentist.

item.title: O novo marqueteiro de Caiado
item.description: Paulo Vasconcelos is no longer the campaign strategist for Ronaldo Caiado due to strategic disagreements, according to an official statement. The change comes at a critical time for the electoral structure of the Goiás gubernatorial candidate in 2026. The full article is available only to subscribers of the outlet that reported the news.
